title: The Lantern Relay
premise: A line of figures wants to light a festival banner, but the single fictional glow bead fades whenever carried too far by one person. They pass it hand to hand over short distances, and each handoff leaves a new light on the route until the whole line glows.
hook: This light can travel, but nobody can carry it alone.
visible_action: Glow bead dims in one stretched hand, brightens at a handoff, and leaves dots that connect into a luminous banner.
intended_takeaway_or_theme: A shared task can progress through small handoffs.
gate: Use magical cold light, not flames, batteries, or electrical wiring instructions.

style_application.material: Original paper fibers and restrained glow
style_application.layout: One shared lantern through several hands
style_application.why: Material and handoff staging emphasize cooperation while keeping the token identifiable.
style_application.check: Review every texture, hand contact, glow boundary and light-sensitive cue.

editorial_pick.original_reason: The lantern gives a natural visual focus, a warm ending and a reusable handoff animation.
editorial_pick.proposed_first_version: A short chain of characters passes one original lantern through a richly staged scene. Keep the handoff visible.
editorial_pick.gate: Preserve object identity, contacts and lighting. Use fictional safe props rather than fire-handling instruction.
editorial_pick.note: These are the catalogue's historical editorial recommendations, not current owner-approved selections or guaranteed watchable stories. Reapply the latest comedy/suspense gate.
